name: Marigold drop earrings
description: A pair of open marigold blooms in warm brass. Small freshwater pearls gather beneath each flower and sway from the curved ear hooks.

name: Lotus signet ring
description: A lotus rises in relief from the broad oval face of this signet. The tapered gold-plated band brings the sculpted flower close to the hand.

name: Jasmine strand necklace
description: Ivory jasmine buds form a continuous strand, punctuated by small gold-toned beads. The cluster at the centre gives the necklace a gentle point.

name: Hand-thrown bud vase
description: An amber glaze pools around the narrow mouth of this round stoneware vase. The russet surface changes tone from shoulder to foot, even with a single stem inside.

name: Kolam brass tray
description: A low brass tray with a floral kolam etched into its centre. The gently raised rim catches light around the edge and holds small everyday objects.

name: Woven palm basket
description: Wide palm-leaf strips cross diagonally around this low, round basket. A folded rim frames the open top and shows the shifts of colour in the weave.

name: Nila open cuff
description: A rounded band curves around the wrist and ends in two softly polished tips. The open shape leaves a sliver of skin between them.

name: Champak dome studs
description: Fine flutes run across each domed stud like the folds of a champak petal. Alternating ridges of light and shadow give the pair depth.

name: Anar garnet ring
description: An oval garnet sits inside a smooth gold-toned bezel. Its deep pomegranate colour draws the eye to the centre of the ring.

name: Tulsi leaf pendant
description: A single sculpted leaf hangs from a fine chain. The raised midrib and fine veins catch the light as the pendant turns.

name: Deepam incense holder
description: A low brass form with fluted sides holds a single incense stick at its centre. The shallow circular footprint sits quietly on a shelf or table.

name: Rain celadon dish
description: A pale celadon glaze gathers in the shallow well of this dish. Its open shape leaves room for a ring, a pair of earrings or a small keepsake.
